project.designRead: K8S multi-cluster admin console / SRE & platform engineers / professional & trustworthy / high information density / avoid decorative chrome, keep actions one click away

designSource.styleDefinitionBrief: Volcengine-style professional cloud console: dark navy sidebar, light content surface, single blue primary, high-density data tables, clean sans-serif type.

typographySystem.title: Inter, Noto Sans SC, PingFang SC, Microsoft YaHei, system-ui, sans-serif
typographySystem.mono: JetBrains Mono, Fira Code, SF Mono, Consolas, monospace

visualQualityCheckpoints.target: Sidebar navigation, page title, primary action bar, and data table form a clear top-to-bottom scan path; status colors and primary CTAs are the only saturated accents.
visualQualityCheckpoints.measurable: Each page exposes its purpose within one second; no competing hero or decorative blocks above the primary content.

visualQualityCheckpoints.target: Shared project shell (sidebar + header) is generated once and inherited by all leaf pages via partials/project-shell.html; leaves only fill mutable slots and private regions.
visualQualityCheckpoints.measurable: All 8 pages share identical shell geometry, color tokens, and type scale; only pageTitle, activeNavKey, and mainContent differ.
